blurb: A university town since 1209, where Newton and Darwin studied.

facts.t: Newton entered Trinity College in 1661 and was a professor here for over 30 years. During the plague of 1665 to 1666 the university closed, and at home he worked out the ideas behind calculus and gravity.
Darwin studied at Christ's College from 1828 to 1831, meant for the Church, and spent much of his time collecting beetles. A Cambridge professor, John Henslow, got him the place on the Beagle.
